QuestInfo.name: Aran the Warrior
QuestInfo.0: Athena said she has news about one of the five heroes. Better find out what it is.
QuestInfo.1: Athena Pierce told you Aran returned to Rien. She hesitated for a moment, then suggested you to talk with Lilin in Rien about the details.  What was it that she wanted to say to you? Has something happened to Aran?
QuestInfo.2: You visited Rien after hearing that Aran has returned. Talk to Lilin, who has been waiting for you.

0.0: I heard you were a huge help in Elluel. I am so glad you were there at just the right time. On behalf of the elves, I would like to thank you personally.
0.1: Actually, I heard that Aran has returned to Rien. But Aran is... Never mind. You'll meet her soon, so it's best for you to hear it from her. I'll send you to Rien. Are you ready?\r\n#r(You will be moved to the map if you accept the quest.)#k\r\n

no.0: Are you busy? You must hurry, for Aran might leave town again.

1.0: Hello. Athena Pierce told me to expect you.

default.0: You couldn't meet Lilin? Then forfeit the quest and start again.
